 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION HANUMANTAL DISTRICT JABALPUR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .

This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1 .

This is a bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 18.3.2023 in connection with Crime No.153/2023, registered at Police Station Hanumantal District Jabalpur for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3/4 and 5-L read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that there was love relationship between applicant and prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix has been attained the age of sufficient maturity.
Applicant is aged about 20 years.
Investigation is complete.
Charge sheet has been filed.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

5.
Applicant is a young boy of 19 years of age.
He was having love relationship with prosecutrix who is aged about 17 years.
Investigation is complete.
Charge sheet has been filed.
6 . Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
